dek: Lynchings of Black victims in August of each sampled year as the standard inventories record them (Beck and Tolnay’s 2022 inventory of twelve Southern states: lynchings, probable and possible lynchings; Seguin and Rigby’s national inventory; the Historical American Lynching data; and the Monroe Work Today map data, which gives the month but not the day, used under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), set beside our event table and dossiers. A row names one victim; when inventories list the same person, the rows are joined. Our record is the table event linked to that row, or an event that names the victim within three weeks in the same state. Below each year are the completed lynchings our sources report that no inventory lists, with any victim not recorded as white. Links open the full dossier. Drafts: no entry has had human review.
